item.content:encoded:
Gut. Thyroid. Migraines. Autoimmune. Fatigue.

Utilizing Functional Medicine and Applied Kinesiology to get results naturally.

Free Leaky Gut Ebook Schedule Here "Two roads diverged in a wood, and I—I took the one less traveled by,And that has made all the difference."- Robert Frost, The Road Not Taken

AREAS OF FOCUS

It is all about balance. When things go awry, it is almost always due to getting out of balance. The following are common areas of concern. 
  • Gut and Digestion Health
  • Headaches and Chronic Pain
  • Fatigue and Thyroid Health
  • Autoimmunity
  • Hormonal Health
  • Insulin Resistance and Metabolic Health
  • Stress
  • Anxiety and Depression

WHAT TO EXPECT

To support your goals of achieving optimal health, we will go through a thorough process to get at the root of your ailments. 
  • Comprehensive Health History and Exam
  • Systems Health Care Technique
  • Full Doctor Access
  • Individualized Treatment Plan
  • Advanced Lab Analysis
  • Minimal Follow-ups for Maximal Benefits
  • Manual Therapies
  • Nutrition and Lifestyle recommendations
 

Over 1000 hours in Nutrition and Functional Medicine

I spent hundreds of hours in seminars, books, lectures, and watching informational videos to understand the human body so that I can help others by addressing the root cause of illness. The body is truly remarkable. If we can get out of its way and support the natural healing process, wonders can be achieved.

My Story

What Do I Offer For Good Health?

From functional medicine to nutrition consultations to musculoskeletal care, I provide a holistic approach to meet my patient's needs.

Functional Medicine

An in depth look utilizing the latest labs and research to uncover the root cause.

Applied Kinesiology

A holistic approach using neurological testing to fine tune the treatment process.

Nutrition

An ancestral approach to diet focusing on nutrient-dense foods to support optimal health and longevity.

Structural Care

Utilizing myofascial therapy and other techniques to address physical pain and injuries.

Balance Body & Mind

Through meditation, connecting back to nature, and stress reduction exercises.

What People Are Saying

My Story

What Do I Offer For Good Health?

From functional medicine to nutrition consultations to musculoskeletal care, I provide a holistic approach to meet my patient's needs.

Functional Medicine

An in depth look utilizing the latest labs and research to uncover the root cause.

Applied Kinesiology

A holistic approach using neurological testing to fine tune the treatment process.

Nutrition

An ancestral approach to diet focusing on nutrient-dense foods to support optimal health and longevity.

Structural Care

Utilizing myofascial therapy and other techniques to address physical pain and injuries.

Balance Body & Mind

Through meditation, connecting back to nature, and stress reduction exercises.

item.title: About
item.dc:creator: gariciu
item.content:encoded:
About Me

Education:

  • Practical Nursing Certificate - OTC, Springfield, MO
  • Bachelors in Religious Studies - MSU, Springfield, MO 
  • Doctorate of Chiropractic - Logan University, Chesterfield, MO

Postdoctoral: 

  • Certified in Applied Kinesiology & Systems Health Care
  • Completion Apex Seminars Functional Medicine program
  • Completion of Functional Medicine training via Chris Kresser's ADAPT program

Hi, I am Dr. Gabe Ariciu

Let me introduce you to my family and share my health story. Nancyann and I have been married for over 12 years. In 2021, we welcomed Grace Miriam into our lives. In 2025, she was followed by a little sister, Esther Asenath. For us, family comes first and we love to spend as much time as possible with them. We also love walking, reading, and the great outdoors.

My health story is fairly similar to many of my patients. I dealt with chronic migraines for over 12 years. I started to get them in High School. It would often happen on the weekends and end up with me throwing up. As the years went on they started to happen almost everyday. Excedrin was my only relief, if I took it early enough. Otherwise, I would retreat into my bedroom, lights off, and hope that I could sleep it off.

When I went to the doctor, I was given a prescription and said that was my best bet. It helped for a time, but I wanted to get to the bottom of this. While I was at chiropractic school, I took a seminar with one of my mentors, Dr. Stephen Gangemi. He found that I was gluten intolerant. I was skeptical, but I tried it. Sure enough the migraines ceased. It was not the end of my health issues, but it was a massive leap forward. Since then, I have made drastic changes to my health for the better. 

This inspired me to follow in Dr. Gangemi’s footsteps and learn from him and others. I have dedicated my life and over 500 hours of postgraduate education in nutrition, applied kinesiology, and functional medicine so I can effectively help my patients. I don’t want anyone to suffer for as long as I have or feel like there is no hope. There is always hope!

item.title: Services
item.dc:creator: gariciu
item.content:encoded:
Services

Functional Medicine

Functional medicine is a systems approach to health care with the object of uncovering the root cause. The body is made up of multiple interdependent systems. What affects one will affect the other. A functional medicine approach takes that into account and is truly holistic in nature.

We do this through a variety of ways. One particular way is interacting with the patient as an individual not as a set of symptoms. We do this by taking time. The average doctor visit is approximately 8-10 minutes long. As a functional medicine practitioner, I spend typically between 30 to 60 minutes with clients. This allows us the needed time to investigate what is truly going on.

Another facet of functional medicine is appropriate and comprehensive lab work. To truly understand what is going on we utilize cutting edge and in-depth testing. This allows us to capture, in-part, the big picture of what is happening in the body. Through this, a detailed history, and other techniques I am able to effectively and efficiently support the body's natural healing processes.

Applied Kinesiology

Applied kinesiology or AK is a system of techniques and diagnostic procedures to evaluate a patient's condition. It was developed by Dr. George Goodheart in the 1960s. Utilizing manual muscle testing to treat a difficult condition, Dr. Goodheart was able to ascertain what the underlying cause was, a dysfunctioning muscle, and hone in on the needed treatment. AK has since evolved into what it is today.

The manual muscle test is at the center of AK. Through it we are able to assess the state of the nervous system and from there the rest of the body. In a very real sense, our body keeps a score of all the things going on with it. When a dysfunctional muscle is found, diagnostic challenges are used to determine the appropriate treatment and thereby restore proper function. The condition of each person is multilayered so AK functions as a fine tuning guide in treatment.

AK, like functional medicine, is a systems approach that views the body holistically. I use an advanced form of AK called Systems Health Care (SHC). By appropriately evaluating and testing, a SHC practitioner can better aid the natural healing ability of the body. SHC incorporates herbal remedies and supplementation, myofascial work, nutrition, and many other techniques that truly are tailored to individual needs.

Schedule Your Free Consult Now


Click here

Nutrition

My approach with nutrition is an ancestral one. For millennia, humans ate a particular way from what they gathered or hunted. The anthropological data strongly supports this. Chronic disease was almost unheard of anciently. People lived just as long as we do today, so long as they were free from infections, injuries, or warfare.

The agricultural revolution shifted everything in a downward spiral. It brought states of malnutrition. People were shorter, brains shrunk, and chronic disease increased dramatically. The industrial revolution was the agricultural revolution on steriods in regards to chronic disease. In the last 100 years we have seen an exponential increase. We are sicker than we have ever been. We must put a stop to it and we can if we look to the past.

Our ancestors got most of their energy from animal-based foods. They also ate what they could gather. Lots of fruit, honey, some vegetables and roots, and on occasion nuts and seeds. Generally, they ate the opposite of the way we do today. Helping people understand this and incorporate it into their lives is a crucial part of my treatment process. And better yet, it is one of the best ways to live a long and healthy life.

Structural Care

Movement is life. Without it, we die. Another thing modern society has brought us is the age of convenience. Our ancestors walked approximately 5 miles per day. They carried, lifted, threw, jumped, and sprinted. They didn't have to think about this, it was just part of life. Now we rarely have to lift a finger to do anything. I am not saying we need to give up modern conveniences. But we need to address them appropriately if we want to be and stay healthy.

Resistance training and walking are some of my go-to exercises everyday and I encourage my patients to do the same. Resistance training is one of the best ways to support overall health and longevity. Walking is a crucial part of life too especially in nature. These in combination with corrective exercise can go a long way at achieving and maintaining a healthy lifestyle.

All that being said, oftentimes we still deal with pain from injuries or accidents. Maybe we are just having a setback or want to reach a new PR. Myofascial work is one of my primary treatments I use to help people recover. And in conjunction with AK, I am able to ascertain what is going on and what needs to be treated. These tools allow me to get to the heart of the matter quickly and effectively. 

Balance Body & Mind

Meditation is one of the most important practices I do everyday. For the longest time I ignored it. I thought prayer was sufficient, but I was wrong. It has helped me in many ways. I am still a novice at it, but it is an important component when I work with a patient. Finding the time to still your mind can do wonders.

We need to connect back with nature. We have become divorced from it, a divorce that never should have happened. We are connected to it. I often recommend nature walking, but whatever the activity, getting back to our roots in nature is tremendously important. It can improve immune function, reduce stress, and boost mood among many things.

Lastly, stress reduction in general. There are many ways to do this, but we live in an over-stressed society. We overwork, overthink, and overdo. We need to slow down. We need to be present, mindful. Much of what ails us stems from stress. If we can take the time to do this we will find ourselves balanced both body and mind, and with nature once again.

We do this through a variety of ways. One particular way is interacting with the patient as an individual not as a set of symptoms. We do this by taking time. The average doctor visit is approximately 8-10 minutes long. As a functional medicine practitioner, I spend typically between 30 to 60 minutes with clients. This allows us the needed time to investigate what is truly going on.<\/p>

Another facet of functional medicine is appropriate and comprehensive lab work. To truly understand what is going on we utilize cutting edge and in-depth testing. This allows us to capture, in-part, the big picture of what is happening in the body. Applied kinesiology or AK is a system of techniques and diagnostic procedures to evaluate a patient's condition. It was developed by Dr. George Goodheart in the 1960s.\u00a0Utilizing manual muscle testing to treat a difficult condition, Dr. Goodheart was able to ascertain what the underlying cause was, a dysfunctioning muscle, and hone in on the needed treatment. AK has since evolved into what it is today.<\/span><\/p>

The manual muscle test is at the center of AK. Through it we are able to assess the state of the nervous system and from there the rest of the body. In a very real sense, our body keeps a score of all the things going on with it. When a dysfunctional muscle is found, diagnostic challenges are used to determine the appropriate treatment and thereby restore proper function. The condition of each person is multilayered so AK functions as a fine tuning guide in treatment.<\/span><\/p>

AK, like functional medicine, is a systems approach that views the body holistically. I use an advanced form of AK called Systems Health Care<\/a> (SHC). By appropriately evaluating and testing, a SHC practitioner can better aid the natural healing ability of the body. SHC incorporates herbal remedies and supplementation, myofascial work, nutrition, and many other techniques that truly are tailored to individual needs.<\/span><\/p>","_padding":{"unit":"px","top":"20","right":"0","bottom":"20","left":"0","isLinked":false}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"text-editor"}],"isInner":"1"}],"isInner":"1"}],"isInner":""}],"isInner":""},{"id":"8c0a42a","elType":"section","settings":{"background_background":"classic","__globals__":{"background_color":"globals\/colors?id=astglobalcolor1"}},"elements":[{"id":"14663ff","elType":"column","settings":{"_column_size":100,"_inline_size":null},"elements":[{"id":"d189da1","elType":"widget","settings":{"editor":"

My approach with nutrition is an ancestral one. For millennia, humans ate a particular way from what they gathered or hunted. The anthropological data strongly supports this. Chronic disease was almost unheard of anciently. People lived just as long as we do today, so long as they were free from infections, injuries, or warfare.<\/p>

The agricultural revolution shifted everything in a downward spiral. It brought states of malnutrition. People were shorter, brains shrunk, and chronic disease increased dramatically. The industrial revolution was the agricultural revolution on steriods in regards to chronic disease. In the last 100 years we have seen an exponential increase. We are sicker than we have ever been. We must put a stop to it and we can if we look to the past.<\/p>

Our ancestors got most of their energy from animal-based foods. They also ate what they could gather. Lots of fruit, honey, some vegetables and roots, and on occasion nuts and seeds. Generally, they ate the opposite of the way we do today. Helping people understand this and incorporate it into their lives is a crucial part of my treatment process. And better yet, it is one of the best ways to live a long and healthy item.dc:creator: gariciu
item.content:encoded:
Health Topics

A Trusted Source for Health and Wellness

From time to time I will write articles on different health related topic that I think may be of interest to you. Also, don't forget to check out my social media pages for other posts!

item.title: An Innovative Approach Utilizing Functional Medicine: SIBO
item.dc:creator: gariciu
item.content:encoded:
An Innovative Natural Approach to Restoring Gut Health

Personalized functional medicine care to support healthy digestion and gut balance.
Start Your Journey to a Healthy Gut

Do You Suffer From ANY of the Following? 

  • Diarrhea
  • Constipation
  • Bloating or Gas
  • Indigestion or Heartburn
  • Depression, Anxiety
  • Fatigue
  • Brain Fog
  • SIBO/IBS

You’re not alone — these symptoms often indicate underlying gut imbalances. Functional medicine combined with applied kinesiology can provide the support your body needs.

Book Your Gut Health Consultation

Root-Cause Functional Gut Support

1. Find

You have to do a thorough investigation to uncover the root cause. Things do not go awry without a reason. If you do not find the primary DRIVER, the DYSFUNCTION will continue. The driver is not the same for everyone, neither is there a set protocol that will work for everyone. And gut issues are varied. I see many who suffer from SIBO (small intestine bacterial overgrowth), IBS (irritable bowel syndrome) and other gut related issues.

At my Springfield office, I take the time to take thorough health history, go over lab work (order if necessary), utilize a technique called Systems Health Care to narrow the problem down further. There is always a primary driver to dysfunction in the body, it does NOT randomly appear for no reason.

Free Leaky Gut Ebook

2. Support

Fixing gut issues such as SIBO and IBS require specific dietary modifications and herbal supplementation to promote a healthy gut microbiome. A broad approach often misses the mark. I will do my best to make sure there is no stone left unturned; finding the specific solution to your issue. That is why it is important to take a holistic approach and account for every component that is driving the issues. Check out the free ebook above for even more info!

Let's Improve Your Gut Health Together

3. Stabilize👍

I may recommend lifestyle changes that are lifelong. As necessary, these may include any provoking activities, dietary modifications, and supplement recommendations. I have found that addressing these areas and maintaining the needed changes will keep recurrent issues from ever returning. My goal is for each of my patients to become independent in their own healthcare. In other words, my hope is to never see you again - even though I am always here for you and thoroughly enjoy being with everyone!

I really want to help everyone feel better and perform optimally, I am passionate about natural health. I am not one to hold back information. Please feel free to contact me anytime with any questions or concerns.

  • Detailed questions please email me at doc@drariciu.com
  • Scheduling - text/call 479-310-6745 (quickest scheduling method is below).

Schedule Today!

Schedule 15 Minute Risk Free Consult! Book Your New Patient Appointment Now!

In Health,

Gabe Ariciu, DC

    At my Springfield office, I take the time to take thorough health history, go over lab work (order if necessary), utilize a technique called\u00a0Systems Health Care<\/a>\u00a0to narrow the problem down further.<\/span>\u00a0There is always a primary driver to dysfunction in the body, it does NOT randomly appear for no reason.<\/span><\/p>"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"text-editor"},{"id":"4deb7f5","elType":"widget","settings":{"text":"Free Leaky Gut Ebook","align":"center","size":"md","icon_indent":{"unit":"px","size":15,"sizes":[]},"typography_typography":"custom","typography_font_size":{"unit":"px","size":29,"sizes":[]},"border_border":"solid","button_box_shadow_box_shadow":{"horizontal":0,"vertical":0,"blur":10,"spread":0,"color":"rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.46)"},"__globals__":{"background_color":"globals\/colors?id=astglobalcolor0"},"link":{"url":"https:\/\/drariciu.com\/wp-content\/uploads\/2022\/11\/Dr.-Gabes-Leaky-Gut-ebook.pdf","is_external":"","nofollow":"","custom_attributes":""},"text_shadow_text_shadow_type":"yes","selected_icon":{"value":"fas fa-book-open","library":"fa-solid"}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"button"},{"id":"080c699","elType":"widget","settings":{"title":"2. item.title: An Innovative Approach Utilizing Functional Medicine
item.dc:creator: gariciu
item.content:encoded:
An Innovative Approach to Functional Medicine for People Who’ve Tried Everything

Tired of feeling off? Let's Find Out What's Really Going On.

Find the Root Cause of Your Health Concerns

Whether you're struggling with chronic fatigue, bloating that won’t go away, anxiety that sneaks up for no reason, or mysterious symptoms no one can quite explain — you’re not alone. And more importantly, you’re not stuck.

Discover a Smarter, More Personalized Way to Heal

Welcome to a new approach to wellness — one that looks at the whole person, not just isolated symptoms. Using Functional Medicine and advanced diagnostic tools, we work together to identify the root cause of what’s going on in your body, and create a clear, customized path to real healing.

Do You Suffer From Any of the Following? 

  • Migraines/Headaches
  • Thyroid issues
  • Autoimmunity
  • Digestive problems
  • Fibromyalgia
  • Depression, Anxiety
  • Hormonal imbalance
  • Fatigue, Hair loss
  • Sleep issues
  • Bloating
  • SIBO/IBS
  • Diarrhea
  • Constipation
  • GERD/Reflux
  • PMS, Irregular periods
  • Brain fog
Book Your Functional Medicine Consultation

💡 Functional Medicine is Root-Cause Medicine.

🔍 Step 1: Get to the Root

We go deep. I take the time to hear your full story, review (or order) detailed lab work, and use hands-on diagnostic tools like Systems Health Care, an advanced form of Applied Kinesiology. Your symptoms aren’t random — they’re signals. Together, we find the why behind them.

“Symptoms don’t exist in isolation — they’re clues. We follow them to uncover the hidden imbalances driving your discomfort.”

Start Your Functional Medicine Journey

✅ Step 2: Create a Plan That Actually Works

Once we know what’s going on, we tailor your healing plan — using targeted nutrition, lifestyle shifts, and precise supplementation. No cookie-cutter advice. No guesswork. Just a focused, holistic strategy based on your body’s unique needs.

✔ Clear steps
✔ Expert guidance
✔ Ongoing support

🔁 Step 3: Stay Well for Life

Once you're thriving again, we shift to support and prevention. You’ll learn how to maintain your results naturally, so you don’t just get better — you stay better. My mission is to help you become independent in your health journey.

“My goal isn’t to keep you coming back. My goal is to help you get your life back — for good.”

Meet Dr. Gabe Ariciu, DC

I’m a chiropractor and Functional Medicine practitioner with a passion for helping people break free from the cycle of symptoms, prescriptions, and unanswered questions.

I believe healing happens when patients are seen, heard, and empowered. This isn’t just a job to me — it’s my calling. I care deeply about your well-being, and I’ll go the extra mile to help you feel better.

  • Detailed questions please email me at doc@drariciu.com
  • Scheduling - text/call 479-310-6745 (quickest scheduling method is below).

Ready to Get Started?

✨ Book Your Appointment Today
  • ✅ Schedule a 15-Minute Risk-Free Consultation
  • 📅 Set Up Your First New Patient Appointment
  • 📲 Call or Text: 479-310-6745
  • 📧 Email: doc@drariciu.com
Schedule 15 Minute Risk Free Consult! Set Up Your New Patient Appointment Now!

You don’t have to keep “managing” your symptoms. Let’s figure it out — together.

In Health,

Gabe Ariciu, DC

item.title: An Innovative Approach Utilizing Functional Medicine: Thyroid
item.dc:creator: gariciu
item.content:encoded:
An Innovative, Natural Approach to Thyroid Health

Personalized functional medicine care designed to support healthy thyroid function.
Book Your Thyroid Consultation Today!

Do You Suffer From Any of the Following? 

  • Fatigue
  • Hair Loss
  • Depression, Anxiety
  • Weight gain
  • Cold intolerance
  • Brittle hair and nails
  • Dry Skin
  • Brain fog

You’re not alone — many patients feel these effects, and functional medicine combined with applied kinesiology can provide the support your body needs.

Start Your Personalized Thyroid Plan Today

Root-Cause Functional Thyroid Support

1. Find

You have to do a thorough investigation to uncover the root cause. Things do not go awry without a reason. If you do not find the primary DRIVER, the DYSFUNCTION will continue. The driver is not the same for everyone, neither is there a set thyroid protocol that will work for everyone. Thyroid issues are often multifaceted and require a thorough examination.

At my Springfield office, I take the time to do a thorough health history and go over lab work or order if necessary. A detailed lab analysis can be very important. And when it comes to thyroid, it is vital to run a full panel. Then I utilize a specialized method called Systems Health Care to narrow down the problem further. There is always a primary driver to dysfunction in the body, it does NOT randomly appear for no reason.

Start Your Thyroid Support Plan Today

2. Support

Supporting thyroid issues such as Hashimoto's requires specific dietary modifications and herbal supplementation to decrease the overall inflammation and get the immune system balanced. A broad approach often misses the mark. I will do my best to make sure there is no stone left unturned; finding the specific solution to your issue. That is why it is important to take a holistic approach and account for every component that is driving the issues.

Since Hashimoto's is the most common thyroid issue, it is very important to understand autoimmunity. Below I go into detail on some of the things involved and my general approach to it. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ueQaxjjvtFg&t=134s

3. Stabilize👍

I may recommend lifestyle changes that are lifelong. As necessary, these may include any provoking activities, dietary modifications, and supplement recommendations. I have found that addressing these areas and maintaining the needed changes will keep recurrent issues from ever returning. My goal is for each of my patients to become independent in their own healthcare. In other words, my hope is to never see you again - even though I am always here for you and thoroughly enjoy being with everyone!

I really want to help everyone feel better and perform optimally, I am passionate about natural health. I am not one to hold back information. Please feel free to contact me anytime with any questions or concerns.

  • Detailed questions please email me at doc@drariciu.com
  • Scheduling - text/call 479-310-6745 (quickest scheduling method is below).

Schedule Today!

Schedule 15 Minute Risk Free Consult! Set Up Your New Patient Appointment Now!

In Health,

Gabe Ariciu, DC

item.title: Systems Health Care
item.dc:creator: gariciu
item.content:encoded:
“In Systems Health Care, we understand that there is a physiological hierarchy in which health issues need to be treated to remain resolved. We look for specific physiological patterns that are present when a person is functioning well, and we look for other patterns when there is a problem. Expected patterns no longer exist when the body compensates from injuries or long-term health issues. Therefore, the body doesn’t realize that there is a problem which needs to be addressed. Yes, the body can always heal itself – but if the patterns are wrong, then often it cannot do that. Injuries, as well as other health issues, have specific patterns and indicators that should exist, and if they don’t then we, the physicians, need to figure out why. From gait patterns to injury patterns to organ-dysfunction patterns, we are always looking for a pattern, whether normal or abnormal, along with other specific indicators that tell us what to treat first, next, and last. All of these guide us in how to fix the patient. Simply put, Systems Health Care identifies primary problems by identifying and treating patterns in a systematic, individualized progression.” – Dr. Stephen Gangemi, DC, DIBAK, DCBCN
The Why
My experience with Systems Health Care (SHC) started when I attended a seminar in St. Louis. While Dr. Gangemi was presenting he asked for volunteers who were suffering from headaches. My hand shot up. I have dealt with chronic migraines for 15 years or so at this point. And these were almost a daily occurrence. Within about 15 minutes Dr. Gangemi narrowed it down to gluten intolerance. I stopped eating gluten that day and my migraines disappeared. I then devoted my time to learning SHC. The body is made up of multiple systems that are interdependent to each other. What you do to one affects the others. That is why it is critically important to treat the whole body instead of focusing completely on one area. In SHC, we take this into account. SHC is designed to help the practitioner understand the hierarchy of the human body and how best to prioritize treatment. Since everything is connected it is important to have an organized system to approach it. SHC provides that. Through manual muscle testing and other SHC concepts, the practitioner is able to quickly discern what areas need to be treated. There are a variety of treatments employed. Manual muscle testing helps us narrow down what specific area is being effected. Then through the use of myofascial therapy, movement, biochemistry, physiology, and neurology an effective treatment can be given. As you can see SHC is a very in-depth and effective technique that takes the whole body into account allowing the practitioner to confidently treat each patient.
More on Myofascial Therapy
Myofascial therapy is an important part of SHC. Along with the other concepts of SHC and how we are able effectively find the root cause, I like to explain it with this illustration. I like to compare it to Christmas lights. Bear in mind this is a crude illustration and doesn't exactly represent it, but it provides a good picture in a simple way. Most of us have experience when getting out the Christmas decorations the Christmas lights are all bundled into a tangled mess. It is often frustrating to untangle them and you have to do it with a degree of precision. You cannot untangle any strand or bulb you want, but you must do it in order one bulb or strand at a time. SHC is similar with its prioritization with the whole body. We cannot choose an area of focus to our liking, but rather we must follow the prioritization and hierarchy of the body. One of the most common treatments a SHC practitioner will employ is myofascial therapy. Life is all about movement. In order to survive we must move. The body is incredibly good at this and will develop compensations when injured or ill to make sure we can move. These compensations are often due to injuries or myofascial restrictions. Oftentimes the body is able to heal with no lasting issue, not so in other cases. These restrictions can become compounded leading to compensations of compensations. Due to the priority of movement, these myofascial restrictions need to be addressed before treating any deeper issue such as a gut related condition. Further, these restrictions can cause a good deal of problems on their own. Contributing to a broad range of symptoms not just pain. These restrictions do not need to be from an known trauma either, like an ankle sprain. They can come from a number of sources including but not limited to sedentary lifestyle, poor movement patterns, emotional issues, and chemical such as a food sensitivity. No matter the cause they need to be addressed by some form of manual therapy. Myofascial therapy helps correct the restriction through restructuring and reorganizing the underlying tissue. And as I said before, the body is also incredibly good at compensating, there may be multiple layers related to a particular injury. These can lead to abnormal patterns within the body likely affecting its structural support system known as biotensegrity. Therefore, these issues need to be corrected before treating a deeper issue. Otherwise, you are likely treating a compensatory issue rather than the primary problem. This is an important part of SHC and you could almost say it is the hallmark but there many other equally important parts to it. Just having the myofascial therapy done has tremendous benefit to the whole body not just the musculoskeletal system. It affects all other body systems. The myofascial system is interconnected with almost every part of the body and it communicates with it through special receptors. A practitioner who treats the myofascial system correctly, effectively treats the entire body. I hope this explanation helps you understand SHC's importance and why it is a vital and unique part of what I do. It is one of the main ways I know how to effectively and efficiently treat a patient.
Sources:
1. Dr. Stephen Gangemi, Systems Health Care

Yes, the body can always heal itself \u2013 but if the patterns are wrong, then often it cannot do that. item.title: FAQ
item.dc:creator: gariciu
item.content:encoded:
Frequently Asked Questions

Do you take insurance?

I do not take insurance. I do however, provide a superbill upon request so that your insurance company can reimburse you directly depending on your benefits. My rate is dependent on time and not motivated by a menu provided by an insurer. That being said, you can be rest assured that everything done in our time together is because it is what I think is best for the patient. This is detailed further in my office policies provided in my intake forms.

Do you take HSA/FSA?

Yes! We happily accept these tax advantaged accounts as a payment method.

Is lab work required?

No, while important to help narrowing down potential issues driving your problems – many times I am able to establish a course of treatment without it. On your initial visit, we will discuss this in detail depending on your individual situation.

How do you address pain related issues?

Muscle testing is my diagnostic technique of choice to find and address the root cause of your joint pain (shoulder, low back). Since muscle move bones, treating the muscle resolves the bones that routinely need to be adjusted. Learn More

How do you address nutritional issues?

Starting with your first visit, we will go through your personal health history and any lab work to begin developing a list of probable root issues. From there we will narrow it down and create a custom treatment plan specific to you. Learn More

Schedule Your First Appointment! Schedule your Risk Free, Free Consult!

417 Local Resources

This is a resource to find local farms and other services. My hope is to have a collection of everything within the region to help provide good natural products and services. If I am missing something, please let me know.

11051 west Farm Road 116, Bois D'Arc, MO

(417) 224-7024

Stormy Farms

(417) 527-8153
stormyfarms.com
Building a farm from scratch... we sell pasture raised non gmo pork and chickens, fresh vegetables in season. whole or half chickens, fresh vegetables, fresh eggs and coming soon pasture raised pork
joanie@stormyfarms.com

Blue Silo Beef

7226 Highway O Ash Grove, Missouri. (307) 630-2950

Beef, pork, and chicken.

Visit us at www.bluesilobeef.com to learn more and place your order.

Blue Heron Farm and Bakery

417-425-4264
grownraisedmade.com

Vegetable CSA, beef, lamb, baked goods, duck eggs, microgreens, herbs, condiments

Wheatland
thrivefarmsllc@gmail.com

Off The Land Cattle Co.

Grass-fed beef

Rogersville, MO

https://www.offthelandcattleco.com/

offthelandcattleco@gmail.com

Farmstead Collective

Grass fed raw dairy products: butter, heavy cream, yogurt, flavored curds, honey, honey sparkling beverages, organic standard veggies, water buffalo meat, fresh roasted in house coffee, and bean to bar chocolate, and homemade soap with botanicals and essential oils.

Farmers Market in Ava on Sundays

Goodparla Land & Cattle

Providing tender and lean Missouri pasture-raised beef, from our family to yours.

Crystal@goodparlalandandcattle.com

(417) 295-7076

https://goodparlalandandcattle.com/

Clear Spring Ranch

Ann and Bob - Grass-fed, grass-finished beef. They are currently working on bringing in pork and chicken. Located in Mountain Grove, MO. Phone number: 402-750-1655.

Bramer's Farm & Garden Polk County MO

Our turkeys are raised on pasture with movable electric netting, rather than moveable pens, to give them more space. As with my pastured chickens, it is necessary to feed grains.

For our vegetable garden we source seeds through SSE, Johnny’s Seeds, Territorial Seeds, and sometimes Baker Creek. We are not only non-gmo, but “beyond organic” in that we do not even use the OMRI approved weed and pest control substances.

Camelot Cattle Company

Raw cow and goat's milk

1642 Crumpley Drive, Marionville, MO, United States, Missouri

https://camelotcattlecompany.com/

(417) 466-5436

Hayes Family Farm & Bakery

417-777-3910
jmhinckl@juno.com
We decided that we would like to grow fruits and veggies to make a living. We couldn't think of anything better to do than to live off of the land. We don't use any herbicides or pesticides on our fruits and veggies. We just put in a commercial kitchen so that we can provide baked and canned goods for the famer's market and beyond. We are willing to cater to people's special diets whether it is vegan, gluten free or something else, so if you have a special request, then please ask! :)

Providence Farm

417 840-5093
providencefarmMO@gmail.com
5147 Pleasant Hill Rd Seymour
several species of poultry, veal, lamb, vegetables, fruit

Guidestar Farms

573-729-2639

mushrooms, eggs, beef, lamb, goat

Peak View Farm

Seymour
417-741-1075
https://www.peakqualitymeats.com/

White House Farmstead

Fordland, MO

Regeneratively raised, non-GMO, low PUFA, pastured poultry.

417-349-1231

https://www.whitehousefarmstead.com/

Oxbow Ranch

Pasture raised pork and poultry

Sparta, MO

417-501-4520

Ranch.oxbow0@gmail.com

Golden Autumn Farmstead:

Our farm specializes in high-quality, dairy beef products known for their exceptional tenderness and rich flavor, thanks to naturally feathered fat throughout the muscle. Raised without vaccines or chemical enhancements, our cattle are fed non-GMO, fermented brewers grain for a wholesome, sustainable diet. We also offer processed turkey, farm-fresh eggs, and a line of handmade soaps and skin care products crafted with locally sourced tallow, lard, or plant-based oils like coconut and olive oil—perfect for those with sensitivities such as Alpha-GAL.

For availability please call/text 417.288.5294 or visit our website at www.GoldenAutumnFarmstead.com

Millsap Farm

417-839-0847

item.title: An Innovative Approach to Chronic Conditions: Hormones
item.dc:creator: gariciu
item.content:encoded:
Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Ut elit tellus, luctus nec ullamcorper mattis, pulvinar dapibus leo.

An Innovative, Natural Approach to Hormone Health

Addressing the underlying factors behind hormone imbalances through personalized, natural care.
Start Your Personalized Hormone Plan

Do You Suffer From Any of the Following?

  • Fatigue or low energy
  • Weight gain/Can't lose weight
  • PMS or menopausal symptoms
  • Mood swings or anxiety
  • Brain fog or poor focus
  • Night sweats or sleep issues
  • Infertility
  • Low libido

You’re not alone — many people experience these symptoms without realizing hormones are at the root.

Let’s Balance Your Hormones Naturally

Here’s how we uncover and support the root causes of hormonal imbalance:

1. Find 🔍

We start by uncovering the root causes behind hormonal imbalances.
Through advanced functional testing and in-depth assessments, we look beyond symptoms to identify the underlying patterns — stress, nutrition, thyroid, adrenal, or detox issues — that affect your hormones.

✅ Goal: Discover what’s keeping your body from staying in balance.

2. Support 🛠️

Once we know what’s driving the imbalance, we create a personalized plan to support hormone regulation.
This may include nutritional guidance, lifestyle adjustments, targeted supplementation, and Systems Health Care support to restore optimal function.

Goal: Support your body’s natural ability to rebalance hormones and improve energy, focus, and mood.

Take the First Step to Hormonal Balance

3. Stabilize 👍

True wellness means maintaining your results.
We provide ongoing guidance and follow-up care to help you stay balanced, resilient, and in tune with your body as life and stress change over time.

✅ Goal: Create lasting hormone balance so you can feel your best every day.

I really want to help everyone feel better and perform optimally, I am passionate about natural health. I am not one to hold back information. Please feel free to contact me anytime with any questions or concerns.

  • Detailed questions please email me at doc@drariciu.com
  • Scheduling – text/call 479-310-6745 (quickest scheduling method is below).

🗓️ Schedule Today!

Schedule your 15 Minute Risk Free Consult! Set Up Your New Patient Appointment Now!

In Health,

Gabe Ariciu, DC

item.title: Functional Blood Work Analysis
item.dc:creator: tanderson
item.content:encoded:
Functional Blood Work Analysis in Springfield, MO

If your last lab report came back “normal” and you still don't feel like yourself, we're not asking your blood the same questions a standard panel does.

Book Your Free 15-Minute Consult

What Functional Blood Chemistry Analysis Actually Is

Standard lab ranges are built to catch disease. They're drawn from a broad, mixed population, most of whom are not thriving, and they're set wide enough to flag only the most extreme outliers. That leaves a lot of room in between “flagged” and “well” where you can sit for years, feel run down the whole time, and still get told every number is fine.

Functional blood chemistry analysis reads the exact same blood draw against a tighter, optimal range: the window where people who actually feel good tend to sit. Just as important, I don't read markers one at a time. I look at how they move together, because a pattern across several numbers usually tells me more about the underlying driver than any single value in isolation.

This isn't about ordering something exotic. It's about reading familiar numbers the right way, and it's a big part of how I work through the SHC (Systems Health Care) process I use with every patient in my Springfield office.

Why “Normal” Labs and Feeling Terrible Keep Showing Up Together

This is the single most common thing I hear from new patients: “My doctor ran everything and said I'm fine, so why do I feel like this?” If any of this sounds familiar, you're not imagining it.

  • Dragging by early afternoon no matter how much you slept
  • Brain fog that makes focus feel like work
  • Weight that won't budge despite real effort
  • Cold hands and feet, or always reaching for a sweater
  • Hair thinning or shedding more than it used to
  • Sleep that doesn't leave you rested
  • Anxious, flat, or just not yourself
  • Bloating or digestion that's unpredictable

A standard range has to be wide enough to catch full-blown disease in a general population, so there's a wide band inside “normal” where you can be functioning poorly and still land inside the lines. When we narrow that window and read your markers as a pattern instead of a checklist, that's usually where the driver has been hiding the whole time.

What My Functional Workup Includes

One draw, read in full. Here's what's typically on the panel:

  • Complete blood count with differential
  • Comprehensive metabolic panel (kidney, liver, electrolytes, blood sugar)
  • Full lipid panel
  • A complete thyroid picture, not just TSH: free T3, free T4, reverse T3, and thyroid antibodies
  • Iron studies (iron, TIBC, ferritin, saturation)
  • Vitamin D
  • Inflammation markers
  • Fasting blood sugar and insulin
  • An autoimmune screen

If a “normal” TSH alongside real thyroid symptoms sounds familiar, I go much deeper into my approach on my thyroid page.

Who This Is For

  • You're tired in a way sleep doesn't fix
  • Your thyroid panel came back “normal” but you still have every thyroid symptom
  • You have an autoimmune condition, or a family history and a gut feeling something's off
  • Your hormones feel off (perimenopause, postpartum, low testosterone, take your pick)
  • Your weight won't respond to effort that used to work
  • Digestive symptoms keep circling back no matter what you cut out
  • You just want a real baseline before something turns into a bigger problem

If ongoing digestive symptoms are part of your picture, I also have a dedicated page on gut and SIBO issues.

What It Costs, and What You Actually Get

  • Typical cost elsewhere for this scope of testing: $750 or more
  • $215
    My functional blood work package

Running this same scope of markers at a typical outside lab or hospital system usually lands around $750 or more. My functional blood work package is $215, and it includes more than a printout of numbers. You get the draw, the full functional interpretation against optimal ranges, and a sit-down visit where we go through what's off, why it's likely off, and what we're doing about it together. You leave with a plan, not just a portal login.

I don't bill insurance directly, but I provide a superbill you can submit for possible reimbursement depending on your plan, and I accept HSA and FSA.

Book Your Free 15-Minute Consult

How It Works

1. Book Your Free 15-Minute Consult

A short call to make sure this is the right fit before you spend a dollar on testing.

2. Comprehensive History + Panel Ordered

We go through your health history in detail, and I order exactly what your picture calls for, not a generic panel. This is the same prioritization process at the heart of Systems Health Care.

3. Get Drawn

A simple fasting draw at a Springfield-area lab.

4. Sit-Down Functional Read

We go through every marker together against functional ranges: what's off, why it's likely off, and the plan that follows.

Book Your Free 15-Minute Consult

Common Questions About Blood Work

My labs already came back “normal.” Why would your read be any different? Same blood, different yardstick. Standard ranges are built wide enough to catch disease, so there’s plenty of room inside them to feel terrible. I compare your results to functional ranges instead, the tighter window where people who feel genuinely well tend to sit, and I read your markers together as a pattern rather than one line at a time. What's actually included in the panel? A full functional blood chemistry panel: complete blood count, comprehensive metabolic panel, full lipid panel, a complete thyroid picture (not just TSH), iron studies, vitamin D, inflammation markers, fasting blood sugar and insulin, and an autoimmune screen. Do you take insurance? I don’t bill insurance directly. I provide a superbill you can submit to your insurance for possible reimbursement depending on your benefits, and I accept HSA and FSA. How soon will I know what's actually going on? Results typically take a few days to come back. From there we schedule your sit-down visit to go through the full functional read and build your plan together, so you’re never left staring at a lab portal on your own.

Ready to Find Out What Your Labs Are Actually Telling You?

If you're in Springfield, MO or willing to make the drive, let's start with a free 15-minute consult and see if a functional blood work analysis is the right next step for you. You can also browse my full range of services or reach out with questions first.

Book Your Free 15-Minute Consult

Prefer to talk first? Call or text (479) 310-6745.

Dr. Gabe Ariciu, DC · 1736 E. Sunshine St. STE 703, Springfield, MO 65804

DISCLAIMER: Gabriel Ariciu is NOT licensed Medical Doctors (MD). He is a licensed Chiropractic Physician in the state of Missouri. Information on this website is provided for general educational purposes only and is not intended to constitute (i) medical advice or counseling, (ii) the practice of medicine including psychiatry, psychology, psychotherapy or the provision of health care diagnosis or treatment, (iii) the creation of a physician patient or clinical relationship, or (iv) an endorsement, recommendation or sponsorship of any third party product or service by the Sponsor or any of the Sponsor's affiliates, agents, employees, consultants or service providers. These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. These products are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any diseases. If you have or suspect that you have a medical problem, contact your health care provider promptly.

item.title: Specialty Lab Testing
item.dc:creator: tanderson
item.content:encoded:
Specialty Lab Testing in Springfield, MO

Comprehensive blood work answers most of the question. When it points somewhere more specific, this is where we go next.

Book Your Free 15-Minute Consult

When Standard Labs Aren't Enough

Comprehensive blood work is where most new patients start in my Springfield office, and for most people, it answers the question. But every so often, a pattern in your results, a symptom that won't move, or something in your history points somewhere more specific: gut function, hormone metabolism, toxic burden, or a food reaction that won't resolve on elimination alone.

That's what specialty testing is for. It's targeted follow-up, ordered because something specific pointed there, not a bundle of extra tests I sell to everyone up front. You can read more about the full workup on my services page.

The Tests I Use Most

  • DUTCH Hormone Panel
  • GI-MAP Stool Analysis
  • Organic Acids Testing
  • Food Sensitivity Testing
  • Heavy Metals & Toxin Testing

DUTCH Hormone Panel

This is a dried urine test that maps your sex hormones, your cortisol pattern across the day, and how your body actually metabolizes those hormones, not just a single snapshot number. I turn to it for fatigue that doesn't match your sleep, mood swings, stubborn sleep issues, or hormone shifts that blood work alone couldn't fully explain.

GI-MAP Stool Analysis

A stool test that profiles your gut microbiome, screens for pathogenic bacteria, parasites, and yeast overgrowth, and flags markers of digestive and immune function. If bloating, irregular bowel movements, or food reactions keep circling back no matter what you cut out, this is usually where I look next. I go deeper into gut and SIBO issues on their own page.

Organic Acids Testing

A urine test that reads metabolic byproducts tied to gut yeast and bacterial overgrowth, mitochondrial energy production, and key nutrient needs. It's useful when fatigue or brain fog won't resolve and a standard panel isn't giving me the full story.

Food Sensitivity Testing

A blood test that measures delayed immune reactions to specific foods, the kind that don't show up as an obvious allergy. Worth considering when bloating, skin flares, joint aches, or fatigue seem tied to what you're eating but you can't pin down the trigger on your own.

Heavy Metals & Toxin Testing

A urine or blood test that screens for accumulated heavy metals and select environmental toxins. I consider this for unexplained fatigue or brain fog, especially when symptoms started after a move, a renovation, or a known water or mold exposure.

How Testing Fits My Root-Cause Process

I don't guess and I don't run everything just to see. Here's how I decide what, if anything, comes next after your blood work.

1. Start With the Full Picture

Your history and a comprehensive blood work analysis come first for almost everyone. That's usually where the driver shows up, and it's the same prioritization process at the heart of Systems Health Care.

2. Follow What It's Pointing To

A pattern that doesn't fit, a symptom that won't move, or a detail in your history tells me where to look next.

3. Order the Specific Test

I order the one test, or the few, that actually answer the open question. Never the whole menu just to see.

Common Questions About Specialty Testing

Do I need blood work before specialty testing?

In most cases, yes. Comprehensive blood work is where I start with most new patients, and it answers the question for most people on its own. Specialty testing works best when it’s aimed at something that blood work, your symptoms, or your history already pointed to.

Which specialty test is right for me?

It depends on what your picture looks like. Digestive symptoms and food reactions tend to point toward GI-MAP stool testing. Fatigue, mood swings, and sleep issues often point toward the DUTCH hormone panel. Unexplained fatigue or brain fog can point toward organic acids or heavy metals testing. I’ll walk through your history with you and order what actually fits, not a bundle.

What does specialty testing cost?

It depends on the specific panel, so I don’t post a flat number here. I’ll confirm the exact cost with you before anything gets ordered, so you always know what you’re committing to.

Do you take insurance for these tests?

I don’t bill insurance directly for specialty testing. I provide a superbill you can submit for possible reimbursement depending on your benefits, and I accept HSA and FSA.

Think Specialty Testing Might Be Your Next Step?

If you're in Springfield, MO or willing to travel in, let's start with a free 15-minute consult and talk through your picture before anything gets ordered. If you're already a patient, reach out directly and we'll figure out which test, if any, actually fits.

Book Your Free 15-Minute Consult

Prefer to talk first? Call or text (479) 310-6745.

Dr. Gabe Ariciu, DC · 1736 E. Sunshine St. STE 703, Springfield, MO 65804

If you have or suspect that you have a medical problem, contact your health care provider promptly.
